an10.101:1.1: Tisso bhikkhave samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti.
an10.101:1.3: Vevaṇṇiyamhi ajjhūpagato, parapaṭibaddhā me jīvikā, añño me ākappo karaṇīyo ti.
an10.101:1.4: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti.
an10.101:2.2: Niccaṃ satatakārī hoti satatavuttī sīlesu, anabhijjhālu hoti, avyāpajjho hoti, anatimānī hoti, sikkhākāmo hoti, idam atthan ti 'ssa hoti jīvitaparikkhāresu, āraddhaviriyo ca viharati.
an10.101:2.3: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ime satta dhamme paripūrentī ti. 1.
